contract.userJob: Complete an ordered task safely with prerequisites, cautions, and visible stop conditions.

layout.wide: Keep prerequisites and cautions before ordered steps and completion checks.
layout.compact: Use one ordered column and keep cautions adjacent to the affected step.

contract.fallback: Preserve every prerequisite, caution, ordered step, and completion check.

gaps: Prerequisites, cautions, ordered steps, and completion checks lack a dedicated visual contract.
quality.nextAction: Design a safety-aware procedure view with ordered actions and visible stop conditions.
